🇩🇪 A1 GERMAN VOCABULARY: Restaurant (At a restaurant)

der Kellner = waiter
die Kellnerin = waitress
die Bestellung = order
das Essen = food
die Rechnung = bill
der Salat = salad

💡 Tip: Learn der/die/das with every noun.
